note: Crew trust (decision 47): one shared track for the whole crew. It measures whether the crew acts together, never whether the act was good. Committed intent raises it whatever the result; overriding a crew that objected lowers it.

bands.name: Broken
bands.effect: The crew has split. A betrayal or a parting of ways becomes a mission hook.

bands.name: Fractured
bands.effect: No help from each other in combat; payouts get argued over; crew downtime events turn sour.

bands.name: Steady
bands.effect: A working crew. No special effect.

bands.name: Tight
bands.effect: Once per mission, a crew favour: someone takes a hit for you, shares a consumable or covers an instalment (the GM rules it).

drives.name: Justice
drives.desc: Rage at the system: someone has to make it right, or make it pay.

drives.name: Ambition
drives.desc: Wanting more for yourself and your own: out of the gutter, whatever it takes.

lines.text: No kid ends up like my brother.
Someone has to make them pay.
The Ledger keeps score. So do I.
My block deserves better than this.
I'll burn their records, one tower at a time.
One big score, and I'm out.
I want a seat at their table.
My family will live behind the walls.
I owe nobody anything, and I'll keep it that way.
